## Analyzers (1)

### OTXQuery `v2.0`

- **Author:** Eric Capuano
- **License:** AGPL-V3
- **Data Types:** `url`, `domain`, `file`, `hash`, `ip`
- **Configuration:** [View config](https://github.com/nusantara-self/strangebee-integrations/blob/main/.upstream/cortex/analyzers/OTXQuery/OTXQuery.json)
